audit_scope: Official NYC LPC permit/application/designation-adjacent records for Bims-5 candidate discovery, with the existing designated/calendared buildings/sites dataset excluded from candidate extraction.

sources.publisher: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission via NYC Open Data
sources.source_type: Official open data permit/application rows for work submitted to and processed by LPC at landmark sites and historic districts.
sources.description_from_metadata: Contains information pertaining to permit applications for work to landmark sites submitted to and processed by LPC.
sources.license_or_terms_note: Dataset metadata licenseId/license is null. NYC Open Data Terms of Use and NYC.gov Terms of Use apply; public datasets are provided for informational purposes and may be updated, corrected, or refreshed by the submitting agency.
sources.attribution: Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) / NYC Open Data
sources.geographic_scope: New York City landmark properties, individual/interior/scenic landmarks, and historic districts represented in LPC permit/application rows.
sources.granularity: One permit/application regulation row; some regulation numbers may have related application history outside this dataset.
required_caveats: Issue date is an administrative action date, not a construction start or completion date.
Regulation type and WorkTypes describe LPC permit/application processing categories and should not be promoted to physical outcome claims.
Coordinates are row point/geocode fields and should not be treated as exact work geometry or landmark boundaries.
Rows may be updated, corrected, or refreshed after the access date.
Transfer of Development Rights regulation-type rows should not be treated as completed private transfers without independent supporting records.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Ingest selected rows as documented LPC administrative events only, retaining regulation_number, issue_date, address/BBL, landmark context, WorkTypes, coordinates, source URL, and explicit non-completion caveats.

sources.source_type: Official explanatory page for LPC permit categories and review levels.
key_points_used: LPC issues permits for work on landmark properties.
Permit types are categorized as staff-level permits, Commission-level review, or post-approval actions.
Certificate of Appropriateness is Commission-level review; Permit for Minor Work and Certificate of No Effect are staff-level permits.
required_caveats: Used only to interpret permit categories; candidate row facts come from dpm2-m9mq.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use as documentation/context in source briefs, not as row-level event evidence.

sources.source_name: Designated and Calendared Buildings and Sites
sources.publisher: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission / NYC Open Data
sources.use_in_this_round: Excluded from candidate extraction because the task requested records not already covered by the existing designated/calendared sites source.
required_caveats: Designation/calendaring rows document legal or administrative heritage status, not permit activity or physical work.

selection_summary.selection_basis: Curated official dpm2-m9mq rows with issue_date in the target window, non-null latitude/longitude, clear WorkTypes, and additive regulation types not represented by the designated/calendared source.
excluded: Rows whose only useful date was outside 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
Rows where the event would require claiming physical construction/completion from administrative data.
